message:
Yen receipts now show correctly: `Paid ¥500 by card`. The full test suite passes (18 of 18), including the yen receipt test.

The cause was in `formatMoney` in `src/utils/money.js`. It divided every amount by 100 and added two decimals, but yen has no minor unit. I added a small zero-decimal currency list containing only `JPY`, and those amounts are now printed as they are.

`formatMoney` is shared, so cart totals and invoice lines also change for JPY amounts. Nothing else in the repo uses JPY, so no existing output changes.
